commands.command:
python3 -c '
import json, subprocess, time
agent=["docker","exec","ocor-bootstrap-spire-agent-1","/opt/spire/bin/spire-agent"]
server=["docker","exec","ocor-bootstrap-spire-server-1","/opt/spire/bin/spire-server"]

def run(cmd, timeout=30):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

def retry(cmd, timeout=15, attempts=5):
    last=None
    for attempt in range(attempts):
        last=run(cmd, timeout=timeout)
        if last.returncode==0:
            return last
        if attempt+1<attempts:
            time.sleep(min(2**attempt, 15))
    return last

ready=retry(agent+["healthcheck","-socketPath","/run/spire/sockets/agent.sock"], timeout=10)
assert ready.returncode==0, ready.stderr[-400:]
listed=run(server+["agent","list","-socketPath","/run/spire/sockets/server.sock","-output","json"])
assert listed.returncode==0, listed.stderr[-400:]
agents=json.loads(listed.stdout)["agents"]
assert len(agents)==1 and agents[0]["id"]["trust_domain"]=="ocor.test", agents
ident=agents[0]["id"]
parent="spiffe://%s%s" % (ident["trust_domain"], ident["path"])
created=run(server+["entry","create","-socketPath","/run/spire/sockets/server.sock","-parentID",parent,"-spiffeID","spiffe://ocor.test/ocor/control-plane","-selector","unix:uid:0"])
assert created.returncode==0, created.stderr[-400:]
material=retry(agent+["api","fetch","x509","-socketPath","/run/spire/sockets/agent.sock","-output","json"], timeout=15)
assert material.returncode==0, material.stderr[-400:]
svids=json.loads(material.stdout).get("svids", [])
assert any(item.get("spiffe_id")=="spiffe://ocor.test/ocor/control-plane" for item in svids)
print("SVID_OK spiffe://ocor.test/ocor/control-plane")
'

python3 -c "import json
from pathlib import Path
paths = [
    "reports/evidence/G0/OCOR-DEV-0005.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0070.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",

    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0076.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0077.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0078.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0079.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-0082.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-REM-0018.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-REM-0022.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-REM-0038.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G5/OCOR-DEV-0050.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
    "reports/evidence/G5/OCOR-DEV-REM-0023.requalified-fuseki-20261121.json",
]
rows = []
for path in paths:
    data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    roles = data["roles"]
    env = data["environment"]
    rows.append({
        "command_heads": [item["head_sha"] for item in data["commands"]],
        "commit": data["commit"],
        "execution_commit": data["change_set"]["execution_commit"],
        "implementers": roles["implementers"],
        "path": path,
        "repair_cycle": data["repair_cycle"],
        "uv": env["uv"],
        "uv_executable_sha256": env["uv_executable_sha256"],
        "verifier_excluded_providers": roles["verifier_excluded_providers"],
        "verifier_started_by_implementer": roles["verifier_started_by_implementer"],
        "verifier_status": roles["verifier_status"],
    })
errors = []
first = rows[0]
fact_keys = [key for key in first if key != "path"]
compared = 0
for row in rows:
    for key in fact_keys:
        if key == "command_heads":
            compared += len(row["command_heads"])
            continue
        compared += 1
        if row[key] != first[key]:
            errors.append(row["path"] + " " + key)
    heads = row["command_heads"]
    compared += 1
    if not heads or len(set(heads)) != 1 or heads[0] != row["commit"] or row["commit"] != row["execution_commit"]:
        errors.append(row["path"] + " alignment")
payload = {
    "errors": errors,
    "execution_commit": first["commit"],
    "fields_compared": compared,
    "records": len(rows),
    "status": "PASS" if not errors else "FAIL",
}
print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))"
